administrative_amendment.reason: Analyze the already collected, row-paired A/B/C qualification streams under a separate analysis-only identity; attach abs_g to Arm A solely from paired Arm B rows after exact identity checks.

A.name: original-f32-anchor
A.role: exact reproduction gate for F4-CAPACITY-01 cross-block anchor

B.features: same 80 feature semantics recomputed from deterministic replay inputs in f64 and stored f64; simulator/native state remains its frozen f32 representation
B.initialization: frozen f32 initial tensors promoted exactly to f64
B.model: same 80-128-64-1 topology and training contract in f64 arithmetic
B.name: f64-features-f64-model

C.contrast: B versus C isolates quantization of the Arm B representation while holding model arithmetic and initialization fixed
C.features: Arm B f64 feature values cast to f32 then promoted to f64
C.model: same as B, including promoted f32 initialization
C.name: f32-quantized-features-f64-model

diagnostics.exact_collisions: f32-equal feature vectors carrying opposite targets, evaluated within each substrate-side panel
diagnostics.interpretation: diagnostic only; no estimator, feature, threshold, task, or fold selection
diagnostics.nearest_neighbors: Euclidean distance after per-panel per-feature standardization; nearest same-label and opposite-label distances; evaluated within each substrate-side panel and summarized by panel and pooled
diagnostics.quantization_delta: B minus C per feature; report absolute/RMSE/max and standardized per-row perturbation quartiles

population.pairing: Arm A/B/C must have identical stream keys, row order, trial, coordinate, target, and inclusion probability
population.panel: 72 streams = 9 substrates x 2 sides x 4 task blocks
population.precision_scope: only feature computation/storage and model arithmetic vary; native simulator dynamics and native state precision are unchanged
population.row_universe: existing frozen common U* streams; target nonzero; native signarm proposed support; existing row_index mod 256 sampling

question: Determine whether cross-block polarity extraction failure on the frozen 80D F4 representation is sensitive to feature precision near the reference polarity boundary.

scoring.anchor_gate: Arm A fold balanced errors must match F4-CAPACITY-01 cross_block_80d within 1e-8 before B/C training
scoring.margin_rule: offline descriptive subset abs(g) > gamma; reference magnitude is never an estimator input
scoring.metric: IPW-balanced classification error with q=1/p_inclusion applied within each target class
scoring.omega_hat: max(0, 1 - 2 * balanced_error); also retain unclipped value

supersedes.disposition: analysis stopped before model fitting because Arm A lacked the abs_g scoring-only sidecar; deterministic source streams preserved

training.folds: four leave-one-task-block-out folds in ascending block order [303000,303001,303002,303003]
training.loss: binary cross entropy; target y mapped to {0,1}; no IPW in training
training.normalization: per-fold training mean and standard deviation computed in arm dtype; standard deviations below 1e-6 replaced by 1
training.order: concatenated lexicographic substrate-side-block stream order; preserve row order; no shuffle
training.seed_rule: initialization seed 304000 + fold_index; B/C use the exact frozen f32 initialization promoted to f64
